headline: Short edge still only seen in falling markets; we need to map when it works and try a modest long reversal idea

items.title: short regime split test
items.why: Checks whether the short edge survives in both down‑wild and down‑calm periods
items.how: Run two parallel short shadow accounts, one gated on down‑wild regime and one on down‑calm, using the existing short signal

items.title: short exhaustion timing
items.why: Determines if the edge depends on price exhaustion rather than just direction
items.how: Add a filter to a short contestant to fire only after a 5% move within the hour and compare results with a version without the filter

items.title: short entry window
items.why: Order‑book depth is hourly, so entry timing may affect execution quality
items.how: Create two short contestants that use the same signal but enter in the first 10 minutes of the hour versus the last 10 minutes

items.title: long bounce after crash
items.why: A simple reversal after a sharp drop might provide a usable long edge
items.how: Run a long contestant that opens only after a >4% drop in an hour and a subsequent price bounce in the next 15 minutes

items.title: tick‑level book
items.why: Hourly depth hides spoofing and slippage; finer data could improve signal reliability
items.how: Purchase a month of tick‑level order‑book history for the top 40 coins and store it for offline analysis

note: A suggestion list only. Nothing here changes a setting or places a trade; the live race decides.
